notas: Prompts do trailer Vitalício. Imagens no RealVisXL V5.0 Lightning (o mesmo modelo das images-game) em 1344x768; animação com o Wan 2.2 de imagem para vídeo ou parallax 2.5D. Gerar em cor: o preto e branco com vermelho entra na cor, no FilmCraft. Violência gráfica liberada só neste trailer; o rosto do ditador nunca aparece.
estilo: photorealistic cinematic film still, 35mm anamorphic lens, dramatic low-key lighting, high contrast, muted desaturated palette with deep crimson red accents, subtle film grain
negativo: national flag, flags, banner with symbols, american flag, stars and stripes, text, letters, words, numbers, signs, watermark, logo, signature, caption, cartoon, anime, illustration, painting, drawing, 3d render, plastic, doll, lowres, low quality, blurry, jpeg artifacts, oversaturated, deformed, disfigured, bad anatomy, extra limbs, extra fingers, fused fingers, mutated hands, distorted face
negativo_sem_rosto: face of the man, visible face, portrait, looking at camera

planos.imagem: close-up of a man's right hand in a dark suit sleeve resting on an old beige computer mouse on a dark wooden desk, a heavy gold signet ring with a dark red stone on the ring finger, cold blue glow of an off-screen monitor lighting the hand, dark office at night
planos.movimento: the index finger presses the mouse button once, a single click, the camera is static

planos.imagem: first-person point of view from a palace balcony at golden hour, two hands in dark suit sleeves resting on a white stone balustrade in the foreground, the man himself is not visible, below a huge cheering crowd fills a grand neoclassical city square, confetti falling, raised hands and phone lights, warm golden light, no flags
planos.movimento: the crowd cheers and waves raised hands, confetti drifts down, slow push-in

planos.imagem: extreme close-up of a man's hand pressing a gold signet ring into a pool of deep red sealing wax on a blank parchment document, warm candle light, dark wooden desk
planos.movimento: the hand presses the ring down into the red wax and lifts it, leaving an embossed seal
slow push-in toward the empty judges' bench and the round emblem

planos.imagem: the same ornate iron gate at night, now locked with a heavy steel chain and padlock wrapped around the bars
planos.movimento: slow push-in toward the chained gate
upscale para 1920 e RIFE para 24 fps
a golden crown is slowly lowered onto the head of the robed man seen from behind, candle flames flicker, the camera is static

planos.imagem: dawn, a whitewashed prison courtyard wall, a firing squad of soldiers in dark uniforms seen from behind in the foreground aiming rifles, three blindfolded prisoners in plain clothes standing against the white wall, cold blue morning light
planos.movimento: the soldiers fire their rifles with muzzle flashes, the prisoners collapse to the ground, blood splatters across the white wall

planos.imagem: first-person point of view looking up, a heavy ornate golden crown with red gems held just above the camera by the white-gloved hands of a bishop, gothic cathedral vaults and stained glass windows behind, candle light
planos.movimento: the crown is lowered slowly toward the camera until its golden rim fills the frame

planos.imagem: night, a wet city street with cold streetlights, riot police in dark gear firing rifles at fleeing protesters, a young student lies fallen on the wet pavement, blood running into the gutter next to a lost white sneaker, low camera at street level
planos.movimento: police fire, protesters run away through the rain, the blood keeps running into the gutter
the row of dignitaries in the pews kneels down at the same time, candle flames flicker

planos.imagem: the same empty concrete cell, a long smeared trail of dark red blood across the floor leading out of the frame, as if something was dragged
planos.movimento: slow push-in along the blood trail

planos.imagem: close-up of two hands in dark suit sleeves on an old keyboard in a dark office, the hands bathed in harsh red light from a computer monitor, gold signet ring with a red stone
planos.movimento: the fingers keep typing and clicking quickly, the red light flickers

planos.imagem: same first-person point of view from the palace balcony, two hands gripping the white stone balustrade, overcast cold grey afternoon, the huge crowd below stands silent and still, no confetti, no flags
planos.movimento: the crowd stands still in silence, a light wind, the hands tighten their grip on the balustrade
the crowd erupts in anger, raising fists and shouting, a stone flies toward the camera, the hands pull back from the balustrade
a heavy cargo truck smashes through the iron gate, armed rebels with red armbands run in behind it

planos.imagem: a grand marble palace hall with tall windows, smoke in the air, a palace guard in dress uniform lies shot on the white marble floor with blood spreading around him, rebels with rifles and red armbands entering through the far doors
planos.movimento: the rebels advance through the smoke, the blood spreads on the marble

planos.imagem: first-person point of view fleeing through a dark brick sewer tunnel lit only by a handheld flashlight, a muddy hand with a gold signet ring braced against the wet wall, shallow water on the floor
planos.movimento: handheld camera running forward, the flashlight beam shakes

planos.imagem: first-person point of view from inside a large concrete drainage pipe at night, two muddy hands with a gold signet ring raised in surrender in the foreground, at the pipe opening several rebels with red armbands point rifles and flashlights at the camera
planos.movimento: a rebel's hand reaches into the pipe and grabs toward the camera, the flashlights shake

planos.imagem: daytime, a crowded city square seen from inside the crowd, in the foreground the toppled bronze head of a giant statue lies on the cobblestones with people standing on it, in the background a lifeless man in a dark suit hangs upside down by his ankles from the steel beam of a gas station canopy, his head and face hidden behind the heads of the crowd, a dangling hand with a gold signet ring, church towers behind
planos.movimento: very slow push-in toward the hanging body, the crowd in the foreground slightly out of focus

planos.imagem: the same presidential office, abandoned after a riot, shattered window, papers scattered on the floor, an old computer monitor on the desk still switched on and glowing, spattered with drops of blood
planos.movimento: slow push-in toward the glowing monitor
